about: Data handling: a naive CSV reader breaks on quoted fields. The symptom is in the report; the cause is in a different file.

engagement.title: Tally: rent filed under the wrong category

goals.title: The report reads every row right
goals.objective: Every transaction lands in its own category with its own amount.

todos.text: `tally report data/transactions.csv` fails on the rent and book rows. The file has quoted fields with commas and doubled quotes inside. Fix how the file is read, with a test.
